adaptations.reason: Embed the complete React application inside the existing OpenWorker frontend.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Imports use the @skills-manager namespace while module behavior remains upstream-equivalent.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Copy the new upstream src tree first, reapply only the namespace rewrite, then regenerate this manifest.

adaptations.reason: The module is mounted below OpenWorker's existing browser URL and cannot own document history.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Skills Manager navigation stays internal to its workspace without changing OpenWorker routes.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Reapply the BrowserRouter-to-MemoryRouter substitution after each upstream App.tsx update.

adaptations.reason: The embedded module shares a document with OpenWorker.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Theme and font variables affect only the Skills Manager workspace.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Keep upstream theme resolution logic and retarget only its DOM mutation root.

adaptations.reason: OpenWorker currently compiles against React 18 types.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: No runtime behavior changes; the editor ref type matches the host compiler.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Drop this adaptation when the host moves to React 19; otherwise reapply the type-only change.

adaptations.reason: The host uses Tailwind 3 while the copied module requires Tailwind 4.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: The generated module stylesheet is isolated below .skills-manager-root and does not reset host UI.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Refresh src/skills-manager/index.css from upstream, reapply documented runtime adaptations, then regenerate public/skills-manager.css.

adaptations.reason: A Tauri process supports one host builder, command handler, plugin set, and application lifecycle.

regression_coverage: all 86 upstream invoke commands are verified in the host handler
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Merge upstream Rust modules, register every new command and plugin, then rerun handler coverage and Rust tests.

upstream_scope: Skills Manager mutable Skill APIs and ~/.skills-manager storage
adaptations.reason: The existing OpenWorker loader and Skills Manager mutation service own different persistence contracts.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: OpenWorker retains read-only loading while all copied management mutations continue through upstream services.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Preserve both ownership paths and reject upstream merges that redirect OpenWorker state into Skills Manager storage.

adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Update this constant together with the pinned upstream commit and provenance record.

adaptations.reason: Observed Cursor manifest drift and malformed frontmatter must not make local Skills disappear or appear from stale metadata.
adaptations.behavioral_impact: Directory contents remain authoritative and tolerant scanning keeps malformed-frontmatter Skills discoverable.
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Carry the fixtures forward and resolve any upstream scanner change that breaks these inventory contracts.

adaptations.reason: A second lock-free HOME helper forced the entire crate test suite to run serially.

regression_coverage: cargo test with no RUST_TEST_THREADS override
adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Keep all environment-mutating tests on the single shared helper and do not restore the crate-wide serial override.

adaptations.upstream_sync_strategy: Keep the recursive test glob so newly added upstream node:test files enter the gate automatically.
